title: The family-owned company behind Swedish public health starts building with AI
summary: Read the latest articles and updates from the Brickanta team.
body_markdown:
#### Press Release


The family-owned company behind Swedish public health starts building with AI


*Spentab, the family-owned contractor behind football pitches, schoolyards and sports grounds across Sweden, starts building with Brickanta to find risks and opportunities earlier in its projects.*


For almost forty years, Spentab has been laying the foundation for Swedish public health. The company is run today by the second generation Otterström and specialises in groundworks and sports surfaces. Its clients range from municipalities and sports clubs to construction companies such as Peab, NCC and Skanska. Now the company takes the next step and starts building with Brickanta, the agentic AI for society builders.


> "In the nineties we were among the first to mix fine rubber into artificial turf. Today we are among the first to use AI in our projects. It is the same drive: building better facilities, with quality, function and safety at the core."
>
>
> Stefan Otterström
> *CEO, Spentab*


The platform reads project documents, compares them against construction practice and previous projects, and surfaces risks and opportunities that would otherwise take days of manual work to find. For Spentab, that means faster and safer decisions in the early stages, and ultimately more facilities built with the same team.


> If we find the risks earlier, we can build more with the same resources. In the end, it is about more places where kids can run, play and move.
>
>
> Jan Emanuelsson
> *Project Manager, Spentab*


Construction is one of Sweden's largest industries and at the same time one of its least digitalised. More and more Swedish construction companies are now choosing to build with AI in the early stages of the construction process.


#### About Spentab


Spentab is an independent, family-owned construction and civil works company operating since 1986, specialising in groundworks and sports surfaces. The company builds and upgrades parks, schoolyards, playgrounds and sports facilities for municipalities, construction companies, sports clubs and private clients, and manages the entire chain from design to finished facility. Operations are rooted in Stockholm and the Mälardalen region, with sports projects across Sweden and parts of Norway. Spentab is certified under BKMA, the Swedish construction industry's leading system for quality, environment and work environment.


#### About Brickanta


Brickanta is the operating system for the construction industry, built on AI from the ground up, with an initial focus on the early workflows of project analysis, construction contract law, purchasing and procurement. The platform combines the latest AI technology with real project data and construction practice, enabling construction, contracting and property companies to identify gaps, risks and opportunities and produce procurement documents with AI. The team behind it has been building AI since 2018 at companies such as ABB, Fabege, Husqvarna, Konecranes and Lantmäteriet, and is backed by investors who were part of the journeys behind OpenAI/ChatGPT, Airbnb, Klarna, Spotify and Plangrid-Autodesk. Brickanta has raised SEK 75 million in external funding from leading investors including Northzone, Anton Osika and Mario Götze.
